fusions.name: Mile-Worn Stamp
fusions.desc: Brings a rooted heel down, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Kicked Burr
fusions.desc: Kicks a seed burr that deals 4 damage and catches on the target's feet, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Walking Saplings
fusions.desc: Uproots 2 saplings that march beside you for 20 seconds, each striking enemies within 3 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Milestone Oak
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
